Verified verbatim (Tier 1 10-K). Kind is 'acquisition' per the schema's closed FinancialKind enum, but the transaction is a non-exclusive technology license plus acqui-hire -- NVIDIA's own 10-K states 'No customer contracts, existing products, or equity interests were purchased,' and no Groq equity changed hands. summary: Finance layer: 19 companies, 73 financial_links (0 facilities/flows/controls in this layer file). Entity verdicts: 69 publish, 23 publish_flagged, 0 reject. All 42 sources checked: 37 SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K) and 5 Tier-2 company press releases/blog posts. Direct curl fetches to www.sec.gov Archives were blocked by SEC's automated-tool detection despite a compliant, declared, non-spoofed User-Agent (no personal/invented email, no browser-header spoofing); every SEC filing was instead independently confirmed via (1) EDGAR full-text search exact-phrase queries for each evidence quote, checking that the matching document's accession number equals the cited source's accession, and (2) cross-checking every source's accession number, form type, and filing date against the data.sec.gov/submissions API for each filer's CIK -- all 37 matched exactly (no date, form, or accession mismatches). All 5 non-SEC sources were fetched directly and their quotes and publish dates confirmed. All 128 evidence items on companies[] and financial_links[] were verified (127 straightforwardly; 1 required treating a footnote-marker spacing difference in SoftBank's release as whitespace-only per the tolerance rule). This research file already handles the seven flagged review areas well: NVIDIA-OpenAI is correctly kept as an LOI with 'up to'/no-assurance language; AMD-OpenAI and AMD-Meta are correctly limited to the binding first-1GW commitment; no unnamed counterparty (NVIDIA's 'one AI research and deployment company', Oracle's RPO customers, Broadcom's 32%/50% customers) is attributed to a named firm; Alphabet's and Amazon's capex quotes are literal cash-flow-statement/MD&A dollar figures; NVIDIA's $105B SB Energy exposure is correctly framed as a contingent guarantee cap, not cash; the Meta-Blue Owl Hyperion JV terms (80/20, ~$27B, $12.31B lease, $28B RVG threshold) all check out against the press release and Meta's 10-K; and the Groq deal is candidly described as a license/acqui-hire despite kind='acquisition'. Two real problems found and corrected/flagged: (1) fin:coreweave-convertible-notes-2033 -- the $3.0B recorded is only the announced base; CoreWeave's very next 8-K (2026-09-22, accession 0001769628-26-000432, not in sources[]) shows the notes priced upsized to $3.7B (2.875% coupon), confirmed via EDGAR full-text search and direct fetch; amount.value corrected to 3,700,000,000 and description/amount.note updated, flagged since the correction rests on a document the research file hasn't formally added yet. (2) fin:microsoft-capex-fy2026 -- the $115,948M figure is independently confirmed accurate (verbatim '115,948' found via full-text search in the correct 10-K, consistent with the cash-flow statement's 'Additions to property and equipment' line), but neither evidence quote in the record states that number directly (only the $51.4B YoY delta and $139.5B total investing outflow); flagged for this evidentiary gap. Eighteen self-link financial_links with genuinely undisclosed counterparties (NVIDIA's aggregate supply/cloud/equity commitments and customer-concentration notes, CoreWeave's/Broadcom's/Oracle's unnamed top customers, Oracle's/Amazon's/Alphabet's/ Meta's/Microsoft's unnamed lessors and suppliers, Meta's El Paso venture partner) are marked publish_flagged so the public page cannot be read as attributing a company-specific relationship the source document doesn't name. No entity was rejected. Redo recommendation for the next research pass: add CoreWeave's 2026-09-22 8-K (accession 0001769628-26-000432) as a proper source with its own evidence for the final $3.7B/2.875% terms, and consider sourcing Microsoft's literal cash-flow-statement quote for the $115,948M capex line rather than only the MD&A narrative.
